meaning.en: The first line of the list: 1.20-latest on Linux, which ran as 1.20.5 when checked. Latest stops before the download with pre-built builds
meaning.zh: 列表第一行：Linux 上是 1.20-latest，检查时它运行为 1.20.5。使用预编译构建时 latest 会在下载前停止

help.en: Installs Elixir from the pre-built builds of hex.pm instead of compiling its source. Empty compiles from the source. The builds are listed by vfox search elixir hex, and their names carry the Erlang/OTP they need, such as 1.20.5-otp-29.
help.zh: 用 hex.pm 的预编译构建安装 Elixir，而不是编译源码。留空则从源码编译。预编译构建可用 vfox search elixir hex 列出，名称中带有它需要的 Erlang/OTP 版本，如 1.20.5-otp-29。

name.zh: 来自 hex.pm 的预编译构建

guide.en: Write the version as the list shows it, such as 1.20.5, or with pre-built builds a name such as 1.20.5-otp-29. Elixir needs Erlang/OTP to build and to run, and vfox does not install it, so install Erlang/OTP first, for example with the erlang plugin.
guide.zh: 按列表中的样子写版本，如 1.20.5；使用预编译构建时写 1.20.5-otp-29 这样的名称。Elixir 编译和运行都需要 Erlang/OTP，vfox 不会安装它，所以请先安装 Erlang/OTP，例如用 erlang 插件安装。

tips.en: Source builds take about a minute.
Source builds refuse spaces in VFOX_HOME.
tips.zh: 源码构建会拒绝 VFOX_HOME 中的空格。

tips.en: Run elixir with erlang@29.1.2 in exec.
tips.zh: 在 exec 中与 erlang@29.1.2 一起运行 elixir。

tips.en: Names such as 1.16 are not releases.
tips.zh: 1.16 这样的名称不是发行版。

tips.en: Pre-built builds are checked against builds.txt.
tips.zh: 预编译构建会按 builds.txt 校验。

tips.en: Builds without a SHA-256 are not checked.
tips.zh: 没有 SHA-256 的构建不做校验。

tips.en: Detect and link finds existing installs.
tips.zh: 探测并链接会找出已有的安装。
